name: National Baptist Convention, USA

citations.locator: National Baptist Convention USA, Inc., member profile
citations.excerpt: Founded in 1886, the National Baptist Convention, USA, Inc. is the oldest and largest African American religious convention in the USA.
In 1895, this convention merged with two other conventions to form the National Baptist Convention of the United States of America.
The 1880 meeting and the formation of the Foreign Mission Convention was accepted as the origin of the National Baptist Convention, USA, Incorporated.

facts.value: The oldest and largest African American religious convention in the United States. It does not exercise administrative or doctrinal control over member churches.

citations.excerpt: the convention does not have administrative or doctrinal control over any of its membership
